name: Travel Document Checklist
description: A travel document checklist for gathering and copying every paper you need — passport, visa, tickets, insurance, IDs, and backups.

items.text: Passport, valid for the whole trip
Government-issued photo ID
Driver's license if you plan to drive
Any visas or entry permits
Passport-style photos if you may need them
items.note: Validity rules vary by country, so check official sources

items.text: Flight, train, or bus tickets
Accommodation confirmations for each night
Car rental or transfer bookings
Tour, event, and activity tickets
A printed itinerary with key details
Travel insurance policy and emergency numbers
Health insurance or coverage details
Bank and credit card contact numbers
A note of card details kept securely
Currency or travel card information
Vaccination or health records if required
Copies of prescriptions and a medicines list
Any required entry or health declaration forms
Documents for traveling with children or pets
Confirm requirements with official sources
items.note: Entry and health document rules vary by country

items.text: Make printed copies of every key document
Store one set separate from the originals
Save digital scans in secure cloud storage
Keep offline copies on your phone
Share key documents with someone you trust at home

faq.q: What travel documents do I need to gather?
faq.a: Typically your passport or ID, any visas, tickets and booking confirmations, travel insurance, and a driver's license if driving. The exact mix depends on your destination and whether you are traveling internationally.

faq.q: Why should I make copies of my documents?
faq.a: Copies help you replace lost or stolen documents and prove your identity in an emergency. Keep a printed set separate from the originals and a digital set in secure cloud storage you can reach anywhere.

faq.q: How is this different from a travel checklist?
faq.a: This document checklist focuses only on gathering and copying paperwork, while a travel checklist covers the whole trip. Use this to organize documents and a travel checklist for bookings, money, and home prep.

faq.q: Where should I store my travel documents?
faq.a: Keep originals together in a secure travel folder or pouch in your carry-on, copies in a separate bag, and digital scans in the cloud. Spreading them out means one loss never leaves you without backups.

faq.q: Is this travel document checklist printable?
faq.a: Yes. Print it or download the PDF, work through it as you gather originals and make copies, and keep it with your document folder until you return home.
